title: Dolby Laboratories Reports Fiscal Q4 2026 Revenue of $374 Million
summary: Dolby Laboratories reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $374 million and GAAP EPS of $0.86, and expects fiscal 2027 revenue of roughly $1.42 billion.
body_markdown:
For the full fiscal year 2026, Dolby said total revenue increased 5% to $1.42 billion. GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 3% to $2.70, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 3% to $4.36. Cash flows from operations were $400 million, and the company repurchased 4.3 million shares for approximately $265 million.


Dolby also announced a cash dividend of $0.39 per share of Class A and Class B common stock, according to its[Form 8-K filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1308547/000119312526465542/d144812dex991.htm) . "We delivered a strong fourth quarter and an overall solid finish to the year," said Marc Whitten, President and CEO.


## Why It Matters for DLB


The release also sets out Dolby's outlook for fiscal 2027. For the first quarter, the company expects total revenue of $285 million to $305 million and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.41 to $0.56, or $0.01 to $0.16 on a GAAP basis. For the full year, Dolby expects total revenue to be roughly flat at approximately $1.42 billion, with GAAP diluted earnings per share of $2.67 to $2.82 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $4.27 to $4.42. The company said its outlook relies in part on estimates of royalty-based revenue that are subject to uncertainty, including consumer demand for electronic products.
